messages:
sana: Quick policy question for year-end planning: Our Berlin office observes a local holiday on Dec 27, but the company-wide year-end shutdown is Dec 24-31. Elena wants to move her local Dec 27 holiday to Jan 3 to help cover an interview panel. Is that handled as a swap, a carryover, or does she need to use PTO donation?

leo: You can do a one-off swap if the manager approves and it's submitted before the blackout cutoff. If the swap would push hours into the next accrual period and exceed carryover caps, that becomes a manual carryover approval.

marta: FWIW, we don't allow donation transfers for schedule convenience. Donations are reserved for hardship/medical requests and go through the Donation Committee. :no_entry_sign:

sana: What form do we use to record the swap so payroll and calendar reflect it?

leo: Use the Time-off Adjustment form in the People Portal: HR -> Time-off -> Adjustments. Fill in the fields: original_date, new_date, manager_approval (attach email), coverage_plan. Put "one-time swap" as type. Make sure it's submitted prior to Dec 23 cutoff for the year-end blackout.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = Dec 24-31 UTC. Exceptions require manager + People Ops sign-off and explicit coverage plan. https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end

sana: If someone requests the swap during the blackout (e.g., last-minute childcare issue), what's the process?

leo: During blackout, managers can escalate with a short coverage plan to People Ops. We'll triage: low-risk swaps (single day, paired coverage) are likely approved; anything that affects headcount for interviews or on-call gets extra scrutiny.

marta: Also note payroll: if swap increases next-year accrual beyond cap, you must select "carryover exception" on the adjustment form so Payroll can process it as manual carryover instead of auto-truncating.

sana: Great, manager approved and attached the email. Filing the adjustment now. One more ask: should hiring ops be notified so they can reassign interviewers?

leo: Yes — post in #recruiting with the swap date and request backup interviewers. Also update the team's shared rota/calendar and mark the candidate interview invites so others can pick up.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-5021 (year-end swap request). Assigned to Marta.
